source: CAMFAD (Cambodian Farmer Association Federation of Agricultural Producers) student thesis: "Establishment of a New Coconut Plantation Farm" (ការស្តាបនាកសិដ្ឋាន ជំណាំដូងរបួង), by students of the National School of Agriculture, submitted July 1994
text:
This 1994 farm-establishment thesis plans a new coconut plantation on land located along National Road 4, roughly 60 km from Preah Sihanouk (Sihanoukville) city. The site sits within Preah Sihanouk province, bordered on one side by a stretch of National Road 4 and, on another side, by about 6 km of coastal road. The land is described as flat, savanna-type terrain with sandy soil in places, considered suitable for a range of crops. The plantation area proposed for this new development is roughly 10-12 hectares along the coastal road corridor.

The thesis frames the project within a broader government push to intensify and diversify agriculture and bring under-used land into productive use, presenting the new coconut plantation as both a private farm income project and a contribution to national agricultural development, since coconut is described as a widely useful perennial crop with strong domestic and export product potential.
